title: PMJAY Cashless Enhancement Requisition
content:
SOP: PMJAY Cashless Enhancement Requisition (SOP-PMJ-001)
DEPARTMENT: Insurance and TPA
VERSION: 3.2
ROLES: insurance_tpa, billing
PURPOSE: Submit interim package enhancements to state nodal agency within 24h.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of PMJAY Cashless Enhancement Requisition in full compliance with Insurance and TPA hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of PMJAY Cashless Enhancement Requisition in full compliance with Insurance and TPA hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of PMJAY Cashless Enhancement Requisition in full compliance with Insurance and TPA hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of PMJAY Cashless Enhancement Requisition in full compliance with Insurance and TPA hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of PMJAY Cashless Enhancement Requisition in full compliance with Insurance and TPA hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Insurance and TPA.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
